d: France has accused a covert Iranian offensive cyber unit of being behind the hack on supermarket fridges and freezers in October. French authorities say that hackers linked to Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps managed to break through weak passwords and other security flaws in the fridges, and then turn on their defrost function remotely. Firstpost looks at the fridge hacks across Europe, and how France intends to target Iran over the attack.
